text_block_list.text:
One morning, as I'm heading to my
office...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This is a robot training method that appeared in Cyborg Warrior Robomin.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Temporary interruption in memory
confirmed. I
believe I dozed off for a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The cause is most likely due to repeated

late-night viewings of the
aforementioned show.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I believe that the calculated movements
of the
robot will serve as a good
reference for my
training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, in order to finish all five
seasons, I will
require over six more
months of viewing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yawn... I will work hard on this as part of my training.

Mihono Bourbon sleepily continues her
robot
show-inspired training.
